name: Sati: Meditate & Study
subtitle: Meditate, study, scroll less
promotional_text: Free from the Buddhist Society of Australia. Meditate, study with focus, meet your phone with a pause, and watch Padma's garden bloom.
description:
Less scrolling. More stillness.

Sati (Pali for mindfulness) is a free practice companion from the Buddhist Society of Australia, a registered charity. Meet Padma, a little clay lotus who keeps you company as you meditate, study with focus and meet your phone with a pause instead of a reflex.

A LITTLE SPACE EACH DAY
• One tap to begin a sit from Home, and a gentle evening check-in after 7 pm
• A simple daily practice: meditate, focus study, read a lesson, recite the Refuges, one act of kindness
• Padma's garden grows from Seed to Sprout to Bloom as you practise through the week

SIT
• Breath meditation (Anapanasati), loving-kindness (Metta), body scan or silent sitting
• A synthesised singing bowl, interval bells, guided cues and an open-ended sit
• Finish with a short reflection to carry into your day
• Save sessions to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes

GUARD YOUR ATTENTION
• Mindful doorways: three slow breaths before a distracting app (five during a guard), then choose to stay present or open it with a clear intention
• Guards such as Morning Sit, Study Hall and Night Rest make the doorway stricter at the times you choose

STUDY WITH RIGHT EFFORT
• A focus timer (25/5, 50/10 or 90/15) that gently counts each time your mind wanders off
• A Dharma library: the Three Refuges, Four Noble Truths, Eightfold Path, Five Precepts, Three Characteristics, Brahmaviharas, Mindfulness of Breathing and the Five Hindrances, each with flashcards

SEE YOUR PRACTICE
• Minutes by week, month or year, days practised, and the moments you chose to remember
• A Screen Time check-in to set your phone use beside your practice
• Daily reminders for your morning sit and evening study

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no subscriptions and no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Sati supports wellbeing but is not a substitute for professional care. If you are struggling in Australia, call Lifeline on 13 11 14.

review_notes:
Sati is a free meditation and study app from the Buddhist Society of Australia (ACNC-registered charity). No login is required and there are no in-app purchases.

How to review:
1. Complete or skip the short intro.
2. Sit tab (centre): choose a duration and Begin. The bell sounds and a full-screen timer runs. Ending a session of 1 minute or more logs it.
3. Settings (gear on Home) > Apple Health > Log Mindful Minutes asks for HealthKit write permission. Completed meditations are saved as Mindful Minutes. The app never reads Health data.
4. Settings > Daily reminders schedules two local notifications.
5. Guard tab: presets and the 'Set up a doorway' card. The doorway URL sati://pause/instagram opens the mindful-pause screen; users add it with Shortcuts' Open URLs action. 'Try it' previews it in-app.
6. Home > View all practices > Screen Time check-in lets users enter numbers from Settings > Screen Time.

All data is stored on device. Content (lessons) is bundled and works offline.
